outcome: Developers open the board and see the whole project: what it is, which stories can start right now and in how many worktrees, what each epic delivers, and why every blocked story is blocked — with epics, stories and tasks labelled as such and a Project > Epic > Story breadcrumb in the drawer. Blocked now reads as blocked on every surface instead of being folded into 'waiting', and a bundled example project ships that the production capture gates validate, so the board can be seen working before a repo has any work of its own.
